blocks.heading: Digital Solutions for *Cleaning Services*
blocks.lead: Grow your cleaning business with smart booking, scheduling, and customer management tools.

header.title: Solutions for *Cleaning Businesses*
header.subtitle: Digital tools designed specifically for commercial and residential cleaning companies.

items.title: Online Booking System
items.body: Easy-to-use booking platform with real-time availability, automated confirmations, and payment processing.

items.title: Schedule Management
items.body: Smart scheduling tools with route optimization, staff assignment, and automated reminders for both clients and cleaners.

items.title: Customer Portal
items.body: Client-facing portal for booking, payment history, service requests, and communication with your team.

items.title: Quote Estimator
items.body: Automated quoting system based on property size, service type, and frequency with instant email delivery.

items.title: Staff Management App
items.body: Mobile app for cleaners with job details, navigation, check-in/check-out, and photo documentation.

items.title: Review & Reputation
items.body: Automated review collection, Google integration, and reputation management tools to build trust online.

header.title: How we *deliver*
header.subtitle: A streamlined approach focused on operational efficiency and customer experience.

items.title: Business Analysis
items.body: We analyze your current booking process, scheduling challenges, and customer journey to identify improvement opportunities.

items.title: System Design
items.body: We design a custom solution that integrates booking, scheduling, payment, and communication in one seamless platform.

items.title: Development & Testing
items.body: We build your system with mobile-first design, test thoroughly with real users, and ensure smooth integration.

items.title: Launch & Training
items.body: We launch your platform, train your staff, and provide ongoing support to ensure maximum adoption.

blocks.heading: Ready to grow your *cleaning business?*
blocks.body: Book a free 30-minute call. We'll discuss your specific needs and create a digital strategy that works for you.
